title: Press Kit Upload
description: A batch uploader where each thumbnail depixelates as its upload climbs — 2×2 blocks resolving to 4×4 to 8×8, then dissolving tile by tile against real progress — and the footer is a two-lane schedule rather than a bar: segments sized by how long each file takes, running ones swept and headed, queued ones hatched into the lane the scheduler predicts will free up first. Hover a lane segment and its row lights up. It opens mid-flight, and the video drops its connection at 61%.
intent: A real product surface with every state finished — queued, uploading, failed, retrying, done, empty, disabled — built on one mechanic (the preview resolving with the upload) on a flat light ground, which is the interface work Herb asked for over abstract demos.
